snippet.title: Frickbear's 3: The Limit - DEMO TRAILER
snippet.description:
A trailer by @FishyyMC !
It's the release of what the kids say is "the most unique Frickbear's 3 mod yet"... So go try it!
Find it on Gamejolt, or GameBanana! Youtube doesn't trust me with links yet, so you can find it under The Limit

Music used in the video:
The Long Way We've Come - SH2K (Uncanny Cat Golf Playtest 2)
